title: •Tarkin
caption: •Tarkin (V)
lore: Imperial Governor of the Seswenna Sector. Conceived and implemented the Death Star project. A *leader* in the effort to crush the Rebellion.
game_text: Adds one battle destiny if with Vader (or a Rebel at a mobile site). Jar Jar and opponent’s spies may not deploy to Death Star. Once per game, may ▲ Hyperwave Scan, Put All Sections On Alert, or an ISB agent.
